summary: Forefront Tech Holdings Acquisition Corp, a Cayman-incorporated blank-check company listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K/A correcting its original May 5, 2026 current report covering its IPO closing. Corrections state the trust deposit was $100,300,000, not $103,700,000, and the business-combination deadline is 18 months from IPO closing, not 24 months. The filing also corrects descriptions of 355,000 Sponsor Private Placement Units sold alongside the IPO. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed. The shortened 18-month clock compresses the de-SPAC runway, raising liquidation risk; watch for combination announcement timing and any deadline extension solicitation.
